events.headline: Houthi forces complete takeover of Yemen's Red Sea coastline, seizing Mokha port and the Hanish Islands, tightening a blockade on the Bab al-Mandab shipping strait amid the widening 2026 Iran war
Drone strikes launched from Iraq force shutdown of Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline, adding to regional energy-infrastructure disruption from the Iran war
OPEC+ agrees to hold October production steady, citing concern over attacks on energy infrastructure and disruption of international shipping routes
Nvidia agrees to acquire AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, its second-largest acquisition on record, expanding its open-model ecosystem reach
Markets price an ~87-91% probability of a 25bp Fed rate hike at the Sept 15-16 FOMC meeting as inflation holds near 3.4% YoY, above target, driven partly by energy-price shocks from the Iran war
